basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 26-year-old software developer from Ann Arbor, Michigan. I recently got into mobile gaming, and Clash Royale has quickly become a favorite pastime. Besides gaming, I'm a craft beer enthusiast and love exploring local breweries. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy spending weekends watching college football, especially Boise State games. I'm quite tech-savvy and often help friends with their computer issues.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Michigan. My knowledge in gaming mainly comes from personal experience and online communities. I'm self-taught in mixing and matching strategies in games like Clash Royale, and I enjoy learning from forums and YouTube videos.
